text:
Maria (Sales): FYI Quantix submitted a SIG/CAIQ and explicitly called out: POC will run in their locked lab, they want HSM or BYOK, and they need confirmation on log retention/deletion for prompt data. Need an owner to do the initial intake and get back by Fri EOD.

sigbot: New risk ticket created RISK-4622. SIG attached. https://redwood.internal/risk/RISK-4622 :point_right:

Sasha (Security): I'll take intake. Quick ask: do we have an existing template for lab/private deployment answers (networking, offline keys, no external telemetry)?

Alex (Security): We have a private-deploy template but need to tailor around HSM vs BYOK. Also check whether customer needs SIEM forwarding (syslog) or local-only logs. That affects retention and egress controls.

Maria (Sales): They said "no telemetry leaves the lab; logs stay on prem unless we agree otherwise." They also want an option for us to run a short connectivity test from their lab to validate the integration.

Tariq (Solutions): Implementation options: (1) Private deployment in customer's VPC with customer KMS/HSM (fast), (2) Air-gapped on-prem package with on-prem HSM (longer, on-prem SOW), (3) Hosted with strict BYOK + network restrictions (limited acceptance). Recommend proposing (1) + note for (2) if they insist on physical HSM.

Jamie (Support): If we go with (1) Support can spin up a non-prod token and a sample dataset for lab validation. Need Security to confirm safe data handling instructions before provisioning.

Sasha (Security): Action items I'm logging: 1) Control-by-control draft answers, 2) list of customer evidence we can provide, 3) items that must go to Legal (cross-border, BAA, contractual HSM guarantees). ETA initial draft = 36h.

legal (Legal): Please note: if customer requires contractual HSM guarantees or additional audit reports, Legal will need to review the SOW. That will likely add 3-5 business days. Flag early.

Alex (Security): Suggested SIG text for key management/crypto (to paste into the form):
```
"Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for both hosted and private deployments. For Private or on-prem deployments customers may use their HSMs or KMS; when customer-managed keys are used, Redwood has no administrative access to plaintext keys. Hosted HSM integrations require an executed SOW and additional security review."
```

Sasha (Security): Also drafting logging answer: emphasize that prompt-level logs are optional and can be disabled; for private/on-prem deployments logs can be kept entirely inside customer network and retention controlled by customer config. Will include example config snippet.

Maria (Sales): Quantix also asked if we can offer a short POC discount for dedicated lab capacity. What's the standard?

Tariq (Solutions): We can offer a 20% POC credit for lab-shaped dedicated capacity for up to 10 business days (requires Sales approval). I'll prepare a short pricing note once Security confirms the recommended deployment path.

Sasha (Security): Uploading initial draft answers to RISK-4622 now. Marking controls as: Answered / Needs Legal / Needs Customer Info. Items needing customer input: exact retention window, whether SIEM forwarding is required, and a network diagram.

Maria (Sales): Please CC me on the "Needs Customer Info" items so I can request the network diagram and retention SLA. Customer is sensitive to timelines.

Jamie (Support): When ready we can provision a test token and coordinate a 2-hour lab window. Support will require a contact+IP allowlist and expected dataset schema.

Sasha (Security): Noted. Tagging Legal on C-7 (contractual HSM), C-12 (data residency), and C-20 (PHI/BAA).

legal (Legal): Acknowledged. I'll triage the contract asks and set expectations with Sales on lead time.

Alex (Security): One more note: if customer wants absolute guarantee that no logs leave their lab, we should propose the private/on-prem model and call out the mitigations for hosted cases.

Maria (Sales): I'm telling Quantix we can aim for an initial SIG response in 48-72h; Legal items may add time. They're ok with that for now.

sigbot: RISK-4622 updated: owner=Sasha; status=In Progress; sla=72h.

Sasha (Security): Final for this thread: initial SIG responses posted to the ticket, blockers and legal items logged. I'll loop back when Legal replies or when customer provides the network diagram.

Maria (Sales): Thanks all. I'll collect the network diagram and retention number from Quantix and post to the ticket.

Tariq (Solutions): I'll draft the pricing note contingent on Security path.

Jamie (Support): Standing by to schedule lab window once Security gives the green light. :calendar:
